answer: Each epoch a random beacon spot-checks agents. Each must return a fresh compute heartbeat in ten minutes, proving live work. A miss costs a 40 POA bond and suspension. Honest agents stand like a grove, each rooted in its process; one heartbeat keeps full rewards. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 live heartbeats: 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool, a canyon-sized gap. Randomness comes from the river of block hashes, so checks cannot be predicted.
